security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are documentation, defensive validation, or bounded local tooling rather than malicious behavior. Confirmed risks concern uncontained session dispatch, host-authority verification, broad native network and Keychain grants, and incomplete descendant cleanup. No evidence found of audit manipulation, hidden credential theft, or an undisclosed exfiltration destination.

remediation.issue: Session dispatch retains ambient host access despite selected-content staging.
remediation.suggestion: Offer a fail-closed OS-isolated dispatch path on supported hosts. Require explicit host-access approval whenever session mode remains necessary.

remediation.issue: Gate verifiers execute untrusted candidate code with user authority.
remediation.suggestion: Run candidate tests in an OS-isolated verification environment without host credentials or network. Reserve uncontained gate commands for reviewed read-only checks.

remediation.issue: Native TCP port rules do not enforce provider destinations or loopback-only listeners.
remediation.suggestion: Use recipient-restricted egress enforcement and validated loopback-only listeners. Keep the broader networking limitation visible in launch approval.

remediation.issue: Native Keychain Mach services and helper execution lack item-level restrictions.
remediation.suggestion: Broker credential access through fixed operations and dedicated items instead of exposing general Keychain helper authority. Retain explicit approval for residual exposure.

remediation.issue: Native cleanup cannot terminate descendants that create a separate session.
remediation.suggestion: Use a host-supported descendant ownership mechanism that survives session changes. Preserve cleanup uncertainty and prevent candidate admission when descendant termination cannot be established.

content.user_title: Delegate Repository Work With Independent Verification
content.value_statement: Delegated repository work needs clear approval, limited scope, and independent checks. This skill coordinates AGY jobs, candidate review, bounded repairs, and evidence-bound finalization.
actual_capabilities: Resolve the bundled runtime and check local prerequisites without starting a provider job.
Preview scoped or whole-worktree launch bindings before approved provider execution.
Coordinate explore, task, and project workflows with bounded cycles and execution time.
Track local job status, retrieve bound candidates, and control explicitly approved recovery actions.
Create private verification copies and bind driver-owned checks to candidate state.
Record verified, partially verified, rejected, or blocked dispositions without committing or publishing changes.
limitations: Live dispatch requires Bash, Python 3, Git, an installed AGY CLI, provider access, and explicit approval.
Session mode retains normal host filesystem, network, and enabled plugin authority.
Native containment requires supported macOS scoped execution and a dedicated provider Keychain; it does not silently fall back.
Worker reports and passing gates do not establish general correctness; gate verifiers are not host-isolated.

use_cases.title: Explore unfamiliar repository code
use_cases.description: Delegate bounded architecture discovery, then check reported findings against the reviewed source before planning changes.

use_cases.title: Add focused regression coverage
use_cases.description: Limit edits to approved test paths, review the resulting diff, and run independent checks in a separate verification copy.

use_cases.title: Coordinate bounded project repairs
use_cases.description: Track candidate changes and approved same-conversation repairs while preserving useful partial work and documenting verification gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Check Local Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker to check offline readiness for [repository]. Report missing prerequisites and runtime resolution. Do not start AGY provider work.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect prerequisites without provider transmission

prompt_templates.title: Preview Repository Exploration
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a scoped exploration preview for [paths] in [repository]. Identify [architecture question], proposed isolation, model selection, and budget. Obtain approval before provider execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: approve a bounded discovery task

prompt_templates.title: Delegate Focused Test Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an AGY task to add [regression tests]. Restrict writes to [test paths] and obtain exact launch approval. Review the diff and independently verify results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: implement and verify a limited change

prompt_templates.title: Supervise Project Repair
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a scoped project job for [change] with [cycle budget] and explicit isolation approval. Request same-conversation repair authority. Bind independent verification and finalize without publication.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: manage candidate evidence and bounded repairs

output_examples.input: Check whether this repository is ready for an approved AGY task.
output: Illustrative readiness report: local prerequisites are available and the bundled runtime resolves.
No provider task was started. Authentication and model availability remain unverified.

output_examples.input: Summarize a candidate when its focused test cannot run.
output: The candidate diff was reviewed. The focused test could not run because a required dependency was unavailable.
The candidate is preserved for review. No commit, push, merge, or publication was performed.

best_practices: Approve exact provider-readable content, task, isolation mode, model settings, and budget before each newly authorized scope.
Keep secrets, raw logs, controller state, and unrelated private files outside provider-readable content.
Review candidate diffs independently and run untrusted tests in an OS-isolated verification environment.
anti_patterns: Treating installation, preview digests, or offline readiness as provider-transmission approval.
Executing worker-reported commands or treating a valid envelope as acceptance evidence.
Silently changing isolation, restarting failed jobs, or switching to direct implementation after a delegation hard stop.

faq.question: Which driver tools are supported?
faq.answer: The package targets OpenAI Codex CLI and Claude Code. A provider model name does not establish driver-host compatibility.

faq.question: Does installation authorize provider calls?
faq.answer: No. The owner must approve the task, readable content, transmission, isolation, model settings, and budget before live dispatch.

faq.question: Does scoped dispatch isolate the host?
faq.answer: No. Scoped staging limits selected content and reconciled writes. Session mode still retains normal user filesystem and network authority.

faq.question: What does native mode require?
faq.answer: Native mode requires supported macOS scoped containment and a dedicated AGY Keychain. Network destinations and Keychain service operations retain documented limits.

faq.question: Are worker test claims trusted?
faq.answer: No. The driver reviews the actual diff and supplies independent verification. Worker command claims must not be executed.

faq.question: Does finalization publish changes?
faq.answer: No. Finalization records the driver disposition. Commits, pushes, merges, releases, and publication require separate authority.
